pages.text: A sword that stores weapons and summons Treasury Treasures for follow-up attacks when it hits a target.$(br2)It accepts weapon types that the Arsenal Bow can launch, except other Constellation Treasuries and weapons with the Treasury modifier.$(br2)Base attack damage while held in the main hand is 36, matching its storage capacity.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Upgrade the $(l:singularity/origin_tools)Seven Swords of Terminus$(/l) at a smithing table with a Singularity Ingot and the dedicated smithing template.$(br2)Place weapons in its storage before attacking.

pages.title: Weapon Storage
pages.text: Hold the treasury and Shift+right-click, or press Open Treasury, to open storage. The default key is V and can be changed in Controls. Existing bindings are retained; change G manually if necessary.$(br2)Storage cannot be opened during follow-up attacks. The tooltip shows the stored weapon count and total base attack damage.

pages.title: Treasury Treasure Attacks
pages.text: After a successful hit, Treasury Treasures, summoned copies of stored weapons, perform follow-up attacks. The real weapons remain inside, but attacks use their durability.$(br2)The treasury itself does not break from durability loss. If a target dies, attacks can continue against nearby valid targets, ending when none remain.

pages.title: Using the Arsenal Bow
pages.text: The $(l:panakeia_enhanced/arsenal_bow)Arsenal Bow$(/l) can launch the Constellation Treasury. Hitting a target triggers follow-up attacks from its stored weapons.$(br2)The launched treasury waits for those attacks to finish before returning with Loyalty or dropping without it.
